## Version 1.0.0

First regular release of the current community editor. This promotes the preview feature set without adding new save-editing behavior. Future fixes and improvements will follow through issues, pull requests and versioned releases.

Extract the Windows x64 ZIP and run `ctrnf-save-gui.exe`; the .NET runtime is included. `ctrnf-save.exe` provides the CLI. A SHA-256 checksum accompanies the archive.

Both executables now have an original racing save-disk mascot icon. **GUI credit:** thanks to **Ryu7w7 and the [OCTR Nitro-Fueled PC contributors](https://github.com/Ryu7w7/OCTR-NitroFueled-PC)**, whose launcher inspired the editor's visual direction. The WinForms implementation is independent.

**This work was made possible by a wider community.** Read the **[full credits and thanks](https://github.com/vzeol/ctrnf-save-editor/blob/main/CREDITS.md)** for every person and project acknowledged in OCTR's credits and release history. A `CREDITS.md` file also accompanies this release.

Adventure editing, named global unlocks, skins, customization and existing time-attack records are available. Some mappings still need in-game validation; read the [feature table](https://github.com/vzeol/ctrnf-save-editor#what-is-available) and [known limits](https://github.com/vzeol/ctrnf-save-editor/blob/main/ROADMAP.md).

Close the game and keep an independent backup before testing an edit. Decrypted saves only; server accounts are separate.

An About dialog, in-app GitHub links and automatic update checking are not included in this release.

**Contributions welcome:** issues, pull requests, translations and controlled before/after observations help fill the gaps. Please do not post personal saves or game files.

[Guide français](https://github.com/vzeol/ctrnf-save-editor/blob/main/docs/fr/README.md). Licence PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0; commercial use is not granted. Font/runtime licenses remain separate.
